rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A browser automation MCP server using Playwright that provides comprehensive web automation capabilities including navigation, element interaction, media control, network monitoring, security testing, and performance profiling. The implementation intelligently connects to existing Chrome instances when available or launches standalone browsers, offering tools organized into modules for different automation tasks. It supports advanced features like CDP-based network analysis with HAR export, CSP violation monitoring, audio analysis through Web Audio API, and video recording, making it suitable for web testing, scraping, security auditing, and interactive browser-based workflows.
